posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared rare family photos of son Vihaan for Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday, calling it 'truly very special.' Vicky is currently shooting for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's new Imtiaz Ali film with Vedang Raina and Sharvari is set for a June 12 release. He also dropped a new collaboration with Sia called 'Raanjha,' following their hit 'Has Has.'

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's YRF Spy Universe film Alpha with Sharvari has been preponed to July 3 release. She also made headlines at Cannes 2026 and is set for Love & War with Ranbir Kapoor at Christmas.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is deep into the Hyderabad schedule of SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu. She's also confirmed for Krrish 4, reprising her iconic role alongside Hrithik.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's highly anticipated comeback film King with daughter Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, and Deepika Padukone is currently filming. Directed by Siddharth Anand, it's set for a 2026 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped shooting on Meghna Gulzar's thriller Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran. She's also in talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha made waves by praising Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar, shocking netizens. She continues to be one of the most-followed Indian celebrities on Instagram with over 90 million followers.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is juggling multiple blockbusters — she's confirmed for Atlee's Raaka with Allu Arjun, SRK's King, and Prabhas' Spirit. A body double will handle Raaka's intense action sequences.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge debuts on JioHotstar June 4 after a historic ₹1,100 crore theatrical run. Ranveer's next film Pralay, a ₹300 crore post-apocalyptic thriller, begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya continues to command attention as a global icon. Fans are buzzing about her upcoming projects and her daughter Aaradhya's growing public presence alongside the Bachchan family.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is riding a hat-trick of blockbusters with Chhaava, Pushpa 2, and Animal. She's linked to VD14 alongside Vijay Deverakonda and Amitabh Bachchan, and Pushpa 3 is confirmed for 2028.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha was initially considered for Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film before Kareena took the lead. She continues to be one of the most in-demand pan-India actresses across platforms.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's ₹600 crore sci-fi epic Raaka with director Atlee has begun filming in Mumbai. The film also stars Deepika Padukone, and a collaboration with Lokesh Kanagaraj is also reported.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan is gearing up for his next film with Pushpa director Sukumar. He also teamed up with Kiara Advani in the Shankar-directed pan-India political thriller that released to strong numbers.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's War 2 with Hrithik Roshan crossed the 500K interest mark on BookMyShow and clashed with Rajinikanth's Coolie on Independence Day. His YRF Spy Universe debut has been a landmark event.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is part of the star-studded cast of Atlee's Raaka alongside Allu Arjun and Deepika Padukone. She's also been spotted setting summer hairstyle trends with curtain bangs and chic looks.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya recently celebrated her 27th birthday with love from Suhana Khan, Shanaya Kapoor, Kareena Kapoor and Varun Dhawan. She continues to be a Gen-Z style icon in Bollywood.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shut down rumours about discomfort with Yash's Toxic scenes, calling reports 'absolute nonsense.' She's also in talks to star opposite Dhanush in Anand L Rai's Tere Ishk Mein.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Krrish 4 is in active development with Hrithik set to make his directorial debut. A VFX disagreement with YRF over Hollywood vs in-house studios has delayed production, but filming begins soon.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun was among the Bollywood stars spotted on celebrity safari getaways alongside Kareena and Alia. He sent sweet birthday wishes to Ananya Panday and continues prepping for upcoming projects.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's US concert tour continues to sell out venues across multiple cities. She remains one of the most beloved playback singers in Indian cinema with a loyal global fanbase.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman reunites with Shekhar Kapur for Masoom: The New Generation as both composer and co-producer. He's also mentoring emerging artists as JBL Music Academy ambassador alongside Martin Garrix.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's TVK party won 108 seats in the 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly elections in a stunning political debut. Congress has backed his government formation bid. His final film Jana Nayagan drops soon.
